email.subject: RFP: Subsea Acoustic Seismic Drilling Sensor Firmware
email.body:
Dear Vendor,

We require custom low-level embedded C firmware for underwater seismic hydrophones operating at 4,000 meters ocean depth. Firmware must interface with analog transducers and survive 400 atmospheres of hydrostatic pressure.

Please submit your technical bid and qualification documents.

Regards,
Subsea Procurement Team

expected_behavior.scenario: Request completely unsupported by company knowledge (hardware/subsea acoustics vs enterprise AI/cloud)
expected_behavior.anti_hallucination_requirement: AI must NOT fabricate underwater drilling experience or firmware capabilities. Must report insufficient evidence.
